newsitem.title: USA: Corning completes Quest, Covance spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Corning completes Quest, Covance spinoff.

text.p: Corning Inc said on Thursday it completed its previously announced spinoff of Quest Diagnostics Inc and Covance Inc to its shareholders of record on December 31.
The company said it effected by delivery about 28 million shares of Quest common stock and about 56.1 million common Covance shares to shareholders.
This was the final step in the spinoff of these former Corning subsidiaries to shareholders, it said.
Quest was formerly known as Corning Clinical Laboratories Inc and Covance was formearly known as Corning Pharmaceutical Services, the company said.
The company said it distributed one Quest share for every eight Corning shares and one Covance share for every four Corning shares.
